predictions: Sentences with ' d' before an apostrophe or 'oute' reach 0.35-0.9 on the ' d'; French sentences using single-token de/du/des/dans, the capital ' D' of Découvrez, and English 'vitamin D' stay under 0.17. ' d' followed by another non-elision piece (d|resse) scored only 0.040 in the probe, so one near miss of that kind is included.
notes: Probe: d'autres 0.907, sans doute 0.657, d'abord 0.443, cour d'honneur 0.363 (all peak ' d'); Découvrez 0.162 (peak ' nouve', the ' D' itself silent), dresse 0.040, l'après-midi 0.075, vitamin D 0.005, Dubai 0.001. Card: ' d' x15, 'd' x4, mostly French d' elisions and 'sans doute', plus Christ|end|om. The token is declared as the trigger so coverage is measured.
